releaseSummary: Ask Portal Copilot to scan CRM for qualified follow-up opportunities. It prioritizes current CRM and order-history signals, explains the evidence and inference separately, and avoids contacts already covered by open work.
Every suggested task remains a review item until an administrator approves it. The scan does not silently create opportunities or change customer data.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of Portal Copilot qualified CRM suggestions.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
